hook.title: THE SILVER BRIDGE COLLAPSE
lines: December 15, 1967. Traffic stands still on the Silver Bridge, West Virginia.
At about 5 p.m. the bridge collapses into the Ohio River. 46 people die.
It began with a crack about an eighth of an inch deep, in one joint of its chain.
No inspection could have found it. And the chain had only two bars to a link.
